title: Astra Cascade
description: First WebGL2 game on the galaxy. Launch a chrome ball through fields of hexagonal crystal pegs in a cosmic nebula.
detailedDescription: Astra Cascade is a 2.5D peg-bouncing spectacle built entirely in WebGL2. Four peg types orbit a gas giant: Stardust (blue) for points, Nova (orange) to clear the level, Nebula (green) for power-ups, and indestructible Singularity (purple) that warp the ball's trajectory. A high-poly chrome ball with MatCap environment reflections cascades through hexagonal prism pegs rendered with per-fragment lighting and emission glow. The capture bucket sways on a sine wave at the bottom — catch the ball for a free shot. Bloom post-processing, a raymarched background, and procedural audio complete the experience.
controls: Move mouse to aim, click to fire. The ball bounces through crystal pegs — hit all 25 Nova (orange) pegs to clear the level. Catch the ball in the swaying bucket for a free ball. 10 balls per level.

achievements.title: Perfect Round
achievements.description: Clear a level without missing a catch

achievements.title: Combo Master
achievements.description: Hit 10 pegs in a single ball launch
